description.value:
The blow lands, the world goes briefly white, and something in you objects. You are back on your feet before anyone has finished deciding you were down, with a great deal more left in you than the situation warranted.

1st Level

  • Once per encounter, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you immediately regain Hit Points equal to half your maximum and are not knocked unconscious.
    • This triggers even against damage that would normally kill you outright.

5th Level

  • When this triggers, you also gain regeneration 5 for 1 minute.
  • You do not increase your Wounded value.

10th Level

  • You may use Second Wind twice per encounter.

15th Level

  • When this triggers, you also reduce your Doomed value by 1.
  • You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and saves until the end of your next turn.

In Foundry: when damage applied through a chat card leaves you at 0 Hit Points during an encounter, you are set to half your maximum and a message says so. From 5th the regeneration effect is applied with it, and from 15th the surge. Uses are counted per combat: one, or two from 10th.

For the table: damage applied by editing the sheet by hand does not trigger it; the Doomed reduction from 15th; and any use outside a tracked combat.
